{"CommandLine":"# Docker API is 1.52 on server side — watchtower latest requires minimum 1.44 on CLIENT side
# The issue is watchtower is using Docker API client v1.25 internally
# Use an older pinned watchtower version that works with older client APIs
# watchtower 1.5.x should be compatible
sudo docker run -d --restart=always \
  --name watchtower \
  -e DOCKER_API_VERSION=1.52 \
  -v /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock \
  containrrr/watchtower:1.5.3 \
  --cleanup --include-stopped --include-restarting --revive-stopped --interval 60 psclient

sleep 3
docker logs watchtower --tail 10 2>&1","Cwd":"/home/aditya","WaitMsBeforeAsync":20000,"toolAction":"Installing compatible watchtower version","toolSummary":"Watchtower version fix"}
